title: Divisorial charts of a smooth strict normal crossings pair
statement: Let $F$ be an algebraically closed field and $V$ a smooth finite-type $F$-scheme [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let $Z\subset V$ be a reduced effective Cartier divisor [def-weil-closed-immersion], meaning locally one non-zero-divisor cuts it out, and assume that its finitely many irreducible components $Z_i$ are smooth and every intersection of $r$ distinct components is empty or smooth of codimension $r$ in $V$. The empty divisor is allowed. At any geometric point on exactly $r$ components, the divisorial log structure $M$ of $(V,|Z|)$ has an etale-local chart $\mathbf N^r\to M$ sending the standard basis to local equations $t_1,\ldots,t_r$ of those components. These equations form part of a regular system of parameters of the strict local ring $A$; its characteristic monoid is $\overline M_{\bar v}\cong\mathbf N^r$, and $A/(t_1,\ldots,t_r)$ is regular of dimension $\dim A-r$. In particular $(V,|Z|)$ is a log regular pair [def-trf-log-regular-pair].

source.place: Expose VI, 1.4--1.5(i), printed pp. 69--70: divisorial log regularity and rank strata for normal crossings divisors; Stacks 0BIA, etale.tex, lemma-strict-normal-crossings, for the equivalence with the smooth-intersection formulation.
